evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt.

observations.why: Two negated failure modes set in deliberate contrast within one frame — 'No blocking call, and no lost work' — crystallizing the contract's guarantees as matched oppositions.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Two matched alternative paths arranged in parallel grammatical structure — 'either polls … or gets … piggybacked' — doing argumentative work by presenting the dispatch contract's two symmetric consumption modes.
